title: Punch To Deposit
description: A client-side mod that lets you punch a chest or ender chest to deposit the item currently in your hand
body:
## Punch To Deposit

**Punch To Deposit is a client-side quality-of-life mod that lets you punch a nearby chest or ender chest to quickly deposit the item in your hand. It works in both singleplayer and multiplayer using normal inventory interactions.**


**Dependencies**
- Forge 1.8.9
- Optionally: ModMenu to access the options menu


**Features**
- Punch (Left click) any reachable chest or ender chest to deposit your held item
- Works in singleplayer and on servers
- Shows a floating `PUNCH TO DEPOSIT` label above nearby chests
- The label only appears within range
- Toggle the whole mod on or off
- Toggle the hover text on or off
- Access settings from the Mods menu config button or the in-game keybind

**Configuration**

You can open the settings screen from the Mods menu config button or press `P` in-game to change:

- Mod enabled/disabled
- Hover text enabled/disabled


**What gets deposited**

Everything except tools, swords, bows, and shears.
